description: Source file defining factory functions for creating transmitters and related data flow components in a wireless communication system, including scheduling commands, uplink/downlink data, and Ethernet frame pools.

classes.name: transmitter_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the transmitter interface, managing data flow and scheduling for uplink and downlink.

methods.name: create_data_flow_cplane_sched
methods.description: Creates scheduling commands for control plane data flow, with optional metrics decorator.

methods.name: create_data_flow_uplane_data
methods.description: Creates uplink user plane downlink data component, with optional metrics decorator.

methods.name: create_eth_frame_pool
methods.description: Creates Ethernet frame pool for control or user plane, calculating number of frames per symbol.

methods.name: resolve_transmitter_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves and assembles dependencies required for transmitter creation, including frame pools and data flow components.

methods.name: create_transmitter
methods.description: Factory function to create a transmitter instance with configured dependencies.
